stem: Which statement best reflects the assessment of a child with possible autism spectrum disorder?

options.text: ADOS replaces developmental assessment and is always required for diagnosis
ADOS is used in addition to developmental assessment and is not always necessary for diagnosis
ADOS is only appropriate after 7 years of age
ADOS should be the first-line tool for all developmental surveillance visits
ADOS is the standard intellectual assessment performed by clinical psychologists

explanation: ADOS is used in addition to developmental assessment and is not always necessary for diagnosis.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Formalised Developmental Assessment

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because ADOS does not replace broader developmental assessment and is not always required for diagnosis.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because ADOS is an adjunct to developmental assessment and may support, but is not always required for, autism spectrum disorder diagnosis.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because no age restriction like this is stated for ADOS.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because ADOS is not described as a routine first-line tool for all developmental surveillance visits.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because intellectual assessment is a separate process; ADOS is not the standard intellectual assessment performed by clinical psychologists.
